instruction: Use BRL-CAD to read the STEP input file(s) from the Desktop path(s): /home/user/Desktop/base.step, /home/user/Desktop/cap.step, /home/user/Desktop/rib1.step, /home/user/Desktop/rib2.step. Read /home/user/Desktop/base.step, /home/user/Desktop/rib1.step, /home/user/Desktop/rib2.step, and /home/user/Desktop/cap.step. Place the two ribs vertically on the base with rib centers at X=30 mm and X=90 mm. Place the cap centered on top of both ribs so its bottom face contacts the rib top faces. Fuse all four solids. Finally cut a through hole of diameter 12 mm through the cap center and the whole model. Export exactly one STL mesh named /home/user/Desktop/out.stl to the output folder.
